chapter: Tatum, Wiggins and Los Angeles friends
title: Meeting Gerald Wiggins and the Casa Manana intermission trio
summary: He met Wiggins in the Forties and played intermission trio for Ellington, Barnet and Dorsey at the Casa Manana.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: How far back do you and Gerald go?
Gerald and I go back to the Forties.

Here in Los Angeles. He happens to be from New York, but we met out here. I think he was playing with Les Hite, who had a band at that time, and he did some traveling with Les Hite. But I was busy. I had a trio at the time. And I used to play intermission, incidentally, at the Casa Manaña; I don't know whether I mentioned that before. But I was the intermission trio for the Duke Ellington and Charlie Barnet bands at the Casa Manaña, and also when Jimmy Dorsey played there. Well, I was the house utility trio, I guess you'd call it. And that was a lot of fun.
